days.note: Header read off the graphic: ULTRA MUSIC FESTIVAL, MARCH 2019, MIAMI, FL, FRI 29, SAT 30, SUN 31, and a SET TIMES section, one block per stage with FRI.29, SAT.30 and SUN.31 columns. It is the graphic the 2019 lineup page embedded (Wayback capture 20190330072829). Every set prints a start only, so every row is open-ended; starts after midnight belong to the night they close. Stage names are the stage logos, uppercased; ULTRA MAINSTAGE is recorded as ULTRA MAIN STAGE and ULTRA WORLDWIDE as WORLDWIDE STAGE, the names later grids print. LIVE ARENA prints the A State of Trance logo over its Sunday column and is one stage. Under the RESISTANCE ISLAND banner the stages are carl cox MEGASTRUCTURE (MEGASTRUCTURE), REFLECTOR and ARRIVAL stage (ARRIVAL). A smaller word after or under a name (LIVE, DJ SET, a presents line, a parenthesised line) is kept in parentheses, as printed; B2B and B3B join the names. A pixelated name with a time is a set the graphic hides; it is left out.
days.method: every block in the graphic compared with its row: billing, stage column, start and end
